AGACHA.Abrir: Arcano Loot & Luck: draw magic items
AGACHA.Parado: Choose how many cards to draw.
AGACHA.PoolVazio: The pool is empty. Open Configure pool and drag magic items into the list.
AGACHA.AbrirItem: Click to open the item. Drag onto a sheet to hand it over.

Pool.Instrucoes: Drag items or item folders into the list, from the sidebar or from a compendium. Weight sets the relative chance: an item with weight 20 comes up twice as often as one with weight 10.
Pool.PesosPadraoDica: Replaces every item's weight with the default for its rarity: Common 50, Uncommon 30, Rare 12, Very rare 5, Legendary 2, Artifact 1.
Pool.LimparConfirma: Remove all {n} items from the pool?
Pool.Vazio: No items in the pool. Drag items here or import from a compendium.
Pool.Adicionados: {n} items added to the pool ({rep} skipped, already there).

Importar.SemRaridade: Include items with no rarity (added as Common)

Aviso.SoMestre: Only the GM can use Arcano Loot & Luck.
Aviso.PoolVazio: The pool is empty. Set up the items first.
Aviso.SoItem: Drag an item or an item folder.
Aviso.SemPermissao: You do not have permission to view this item.
Aviso.SemPagador: The round has a cost: under "Who plays", choose a player who has a character.
Aviso.SemMoedas: {nome}'s sheet has no gold pieces in this system. Set the cost to zero to draw.
Aviso.SemOuro: {nome} has {tem} gp and the round costs {custo} gp.

Config.PoolDica: Items that can come up in a draw, each with its weight.
Config.IdiomaDica: Language of this module's windows, messages and settings. "Follow Foundry" uses the same language as Foundry. Reloads the page.
Config.MostrarJogadoresDica: When the GM draws, the card window opens for every connected player, with the same animation.
Config.SemRepeticao: No repeated items in the same draw
Config.SemRepeticaoDica: The same item does not come up twice in one draw, as long as the pool has different items left.
Config.Garantia: Guarantee on draws of 5 or more
Config.GarantiaDica: If no card reaches the chosen rarity, the weakest card is replaced by an item of that rarity or better.
Config.SomDica: Plays a sound when an Uncommon or better card is revealed.
Config.RevelarAutoDica: Off: cards stay face down until the GM clicks each one or Reveal all. On: the sequence starts by itself as soon as the cards land.
Config.FogosDica: Full-screen fireworks when a Legendary or Artifact card is revealed.
Config.SorteDica: How much the player dice raise the odds, a table of odds per result, and guarantees (for example: a natural 20 guarantees a Legendary).
Config.HistoricoDica: Every draw and every delivery becomes a line in the "Arcano Loot & Luck: history" journal (created the first time).
Config.MascoteDica: Puppet: a simple drawing in parts, with a mouth that talks, eyes that follow the pointer and legs that dance. Painting: the three painted illustrations.
Config.MusicaDica: Plays quiet music while the window is open.

AGACHA.DicaRevelar: Click a card to reveal it.

Sorte.Dica: Every d20 rolled improves the odds of the next draw.
Sorte.PedirDica: Opens a button for every connected player to roll 1d20. The average of the dice becomes the table's luck.
Sorte.RolarMestreDica: Rolls 1d20 for the GM and adds it to the table dice.
Sorte.Pedida: Dice request sent to the players.

Capa.ChancesDica: Chance of each rarity per card, already counting the luck dice.
Capa.OuEscolha: or pick the amount with the buttons above
Capa.SaborQuantidade: Arcano Loot & Luck: how many cards Nibbles spits out

Fala.boasVindas1: Chomp! You came! There is fresh treasure in my belly. How many cards do I spit today?
Fala.boasVindas2: Hi, hi, hi! Roll the die and I open wide. I promise not to bite. Much.
Fala.boasVindas3: Adventurers! My favourite. You smell like gold and cheese.
Fala.vazio1: My belly is empty… will someone feed me some items?
Fala.espera1: Shhh. I am keeping the cards nice and warm in here.
Fala.espera2: Hands off! I am a very respectable chest.
Fala.pedeDado1: Your luck tickles my lid. Roll a d20!
Fala.quantidade2: The die said {n}. I obey the die. It is pointy.
Fala.embaralha1: Stir, stir, stir… the tongue does all the work!
Fala.embaralha2: Glub, glub… shuffling in my belly!
Fala.embaralha3: Do not look! I mean, look. It is pretty.
Fala.mesa1: Ptooey! There they are. Poke a card to see.
Fala.mesa2: Spat out with love. Pick one!
Fala.fim1: Burp. Excuse me. Come back soon, I get hungry!
Fala.fim2: That was a fine adventure snack. See you next time!
Fala.sorte2: {total} from {nome}! The cards are hopping in here.
Fala.common1: {item}. Plain, but I spat it out with love.
Fala.common2: {item}! Not every snack is a feast.
Fala.uncommon2: Look, {item}! I almost swallowed it back.
Fala.rare1: Oooh… {item}! It sparkled on my tongue!
Fala.rare2: {item}! I was saving that one for later.
Fala.veryRare1: Chooomp! {item}! I have not spat one of those in ages!
Fala.legendary1: LEGENDARY! {item}! I did not even know that was in here!
Fala.legendary2: {item}!!! Somebody hold me, I am going to jump!
Fala.artifact1: AN ARTIFACT! {item}! How did that fit inside me?!
Fala.artifact2: {item}… the gods are going to come search me.

Ajuste.Como: The GM asks the players for 1d20 before drawing. The average of the dice becomes the table luck: 1 is 0% and 20 is 100%. Luck lasts for one draw only.
Ajuste.ForcaDica: How much luck weighs. Each rarity step above Common has its weight multiplied by 1 + luck × strength. At 0 the dice change nothing.
Ajuste.TabelaTitulo: What each result does to your current deck
Ajuste.TabelaDica: Chance of each rarity per card. The table uses the items and weights of the saved deck and changes as you move the strength. Dice raise the odds; only the guarantees below give certainty.
Ajuste.EmCincoDica: Chance of at least one Legendary or Artifact card in a draw of 5.
Ajuste.SemPool: The deck is empty: set up the items to see the table.
Ajuste.Critico: If anyone rolls a natural 20, the draw guarantees
Ajuste.MediaMinima: If the dice average reaches … the draw guarantees
Ajuste.GarantiasDica: Guarantee means: at least one card of the draw will be of that rarity or better, if the deck has such an item. For a 20 to always mean a Legendary, pick Legendary on the first line.
Ajuste.Acumulada: After … rounds without … the next one guarantees
Ajuste.AcumuladaDica: Pity guarantee: 0 turns it off. Counts consecutive rounds where that rarity (or better) did not come up. Rounds in a row without it so far: {n}.

AGACHA.DicaEscolher: Pick {n} card(s): the rest stay behind.

Baralho.ApagarConfirma: Delete the deck "{nome}" with {n} items? This cannot be undone.
Baralho.Ultimo: This is the only deck: it cannot be deleted.

Mesa.BaralhoDica: Which deck the cards come from. Create more in Configure pool.
Mesa.JogadorDica: The chosen player flips the cards on their own screen. If there is a cost, it comes out of their character's gold.
Mesa.ModoDica: Reveal all: every card counts. Pick: only the cards that are flipped count; the rest are shown greyed out.
Mesa.Escolhas: How many cards can be picked
Mesa.CustoDica: Gold pieces charged each round from the playing character. 0 = free.
